description: This is a shell script containing tests and commands related to Git bundle functionality, such as creating, verifying, and cloning Git bundles, as well as handling edge cases and configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, verifying failure occurs.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the content of files or command outputs.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks whether a given file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances internal timestamps or state for tests.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for patterns within command output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test script.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Retrieves object IDs or related information, such as version and algorithm.
